# Third-party libraries

| File | Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js, SplitText.min.js, DrawSVGPlugin.min.js | [GSAP](https://gsap.com) | 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License — free for commercial use (https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| lenis.min.js | [Lenis](https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis) | 1.3.26 | MIT |

Fonts in `/assets/fonts` (Cormorant Garamond, Jost) are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

To update: `npm i gsap lenis` in a scratch folder and copy the files from `node_modules/gsap/dist` and `node_modules/lenis/dist`.
